name: PD 111 was established by Ordinance No. 16289, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 11, 1979. Ordinance No. 16289 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16289; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 111 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 111 was established by Ordinance No. 16289, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 11, 1979. Ordinance No. 16289 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 111 is established on property generally fronting on the north line of Alpha Road, beginning at a point approximately 105 feet west of the centerline of White Rock Creek. The size of PD 111 is approximately 22.19 acres. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-111.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development of the Property must be in accordance with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 111A). (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.105.USES. Single-family detached residential uses are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.106.LANDSCAPE PLAN. The Property must be landscaped in accordance with the city council-approved landscape plan (Exhibit 111B) submitted in conjunction with a flood plain fill request approved by the city council on February 15, 1978. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.107.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat as approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the County Clerk. In conjunction with the submission of the subdivision plat, a legal instrument establishing a plan for permanent care and maintenance of any common area or communally-owned facility must be submitted and approved by the city attorney as to legal form and by the city plan commission as to suitability for the proposed use of the common area. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.108.PARKING. Parking must be provided at the ratio of two spaces per residential unit. In no instance may a required parking space violate a platted building line. Automobile storage spaces located in an enclosed structure so as to face upon or be entered directly from a street or alley may not be nearer than 20 feet to the property line adjacent to such street or alley regardless of any building line platted to a lesser setback and regardless of any other provision of the comprehensive zoning ordinance. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.109.HEIGHT. No structures may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-111.110.SETBACKS.
(a)Front yard setback is 15 feet.
(b)Side yard setback will apply as shown on the development plan and the approved subdivision plat.
(c)Rear yard setback is a minimum of 10 feet. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.111.COVERAGE. Maximum percent of lot area that may be covered by the main building and all accessory buildings may not exceed 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.112.DENSITY. Maximum number of dwelling units in this development may not exceed 42. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Dwellings
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.113.DWELLINGS. In no instance may units on adjoining lots be attached. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.114.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts as specified in Chapter 41, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.115.PAVING. All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must be constructed to the requirements of Section 20-812 of Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: Tennis House
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.116.TENNIS HOUSE. The existing tennis house must be used only by its owner, the owner’s guests, and the owners of the residential units in the PD and their guests pursuant to private contract. No fee will be charged for activities except as provided for in the private contract. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-111.117.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)The Property must be developed in accordance with all applicable ordinances and regulations of the city including, but not limited to, Section 10-1112 of Chapter 51.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article and any of the city applicable provisions of the Comprehensive General Zoning Ordinance of the city and the Dallas Building Code. (Ord. Nos. 16289; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-111.118.ZONING MAP. PD 111 is located on Zoning Map No. C-7. (Ord. 25508)
